A fitness test gives the same result when repeated under the same conditions. It is
Give the difference between muscular strength and muscular endurance with a sporting example of each.
questions.model: Muscular strength is the maximum force a muscle can apply in one contraction, e.g. a 1-rep max lift. Muscular endurance is the ability to contract repeatedly without tiring, e.g. a rower in a 2000 m race.
points: strength = maximum force in a single effort + example
endurance = repeated contractions without fatigue + example
